law_name: Law No. 2016-555 of 26 July 2016 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous and pseudonymous works: 70 years from end of year of lawful public availability)
enforcement_body: Bureau Ivoirien du Droit d'Auteur (BURIDA), under the Ministry of Culture and Francophonie
